dc4ever-2005.date_note: Real development 2003-2005 (C#, .NET). The GitHub repo was created 2019-04-11; its history was rebuilt from backups as one commit per file stamped with the file mtime (2002-01-30 .. 2005-09-15). Commit dates are therefore approximate file dates, not real commits.

nullDCe-2009.date_note: Forked from nullDC mainline late 2008 (README). Committed 2017-11-20 from a recovered archive; latest date found in the sources is 2009-10-16, so placed at 2009-10.

nulldc-2010-05.date_note: nullDC was developed closed-source from 2005; this is the first public source (Google Code svn, r1 2010-05-02).

reicast-2013-import.date_note: Private newdc / nullDC-Android rewrite of 2012-2013 imported as one commit.

nulldc-360-last.date_note: Code activity is 2011-2012 (118 of 123 commits); the 2021-2022 commits are toolchain rebuilds.
